<DOCSTRING>
Manages a collection of users and processes them.

This class is responsible for maintaining a list of users and processing each user to determine if they are an adult or a minor. It is used by various parts of the application to manage user data and enforce access controls based on age.

@constructor
Initializes a new instance of the UserManager class.

@attribute {Array<Object>} users - The list of users managed by this class. This array is initialized as empty and is modified by the `addUser` method.

@method addUser
Adds a user to the system and processes it.

@summary Adds a user to the system and processes it.
@description This method adds a user object to the `users` array and then calls the `process` method to determine if the user is an adult or a minor. This function is useful for applications that need to manage user data and enforce access controls based on age.

@param {Object} user - The user object to add. This object must have a `name` property and an `isAdult` method that returns a boolean indicating whether the user is an adult.

@returns {void} - This function does not return a value.

@method process
Logs whether a user is an adult or a minor.

@summary Logs whether a user is an adult or a minor.
@description This method checks if the given user is an adult and logs the appropriate message. This function is useful for applications that need to differentiate between adult and minor users for access control or other purposes.

@param {Object} user - The user object to check. This object must have a `name` property and an `isAdult` method that returns a boolean indicating whether the user is an adult.

@returns {void} - This function does not return a value.
</DOCSTRING>
